Label Kits
Michaels + KeHE

Select the label workflow

Michaels and KeHE use different backend processors. Select the correct kit first so the upload form and backend endpoint match the data type.

Michaels Label Kit

Use this when you need to match ASN XML packs against ShipStation/UPS shipping-label PDFs.

  • Requires ASN XML files.
  • Requires shipping-label PDF files.
  • Output includes shipping label + GS1 label + packing list.

KeHE Label Kit

Use this when you only need to generate KeHE SSCC-18 / GS1-128 labels from ASN XML.

  • Requires ASN XML files only.
  • Does not use shipping-label PDFs.
  • Output creates one 4 × 6 label per SSCC/carton.
